svg.title: With a message broker: a job enters a queue and becomes a result
svg.desc: Three separate processes on one machine: a Rust producer sends job bytes over a client connection to a message broker. The broker holds the job in its queue and delivers it over another connection to a Python worker, which creates a thumbnail. The broker is a running intermediary service, not shared application memory. No durability setting or performance ratio is implied. Soft green streams follow input, broker queuing, delivery and output in sequence. Reduced-motion mode retains static flow channels.

svg.text: Separate programs exchange messages through a running service.
A running service owns the queue.
